words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) begins the ayah with relation before action. It coordinates this clause with 94:1, so the removal of the burden is heard as the second item in the same divine-favor sequence, not as a detached report. The connector also carries the prior question's compelled acknowledgment across the ayah break, as if the second favor remains inside the same recognition frame. Because the connector stands immediately before {{ar:وَضَعْنَا}} ({{tr:waḍaʿnā}}), the clause even starts with a doubled connective onset: the small particle binds the ayah backward before the new completed act moves forward.

words.prose: {{ar:وَضَعْنَا}} ({{tr:waḍaʿnā}}) is an active perfect first-person plural verb, so the relief is framed as a completed divine act rather than a passive result or request. The first word of the predicate puts divine action before the source phrase and before the burden is named, and the first-person plural agent is immediately aimed at the same second-person addressee carried by the following suffixes. Its local force depends on the construction: with {{ar:عَنْكَ}} ({{tr:ʿanka}}) and {{ar:وِزْرَكَ}} ({{tr:wizraka}}), the root's setting-down image becomes removal from the addressee, not simple placement. That narrowing still leaves a tactile payoff: an abstract burden is treated as something that can be moved, set away, and no longer left on the person. The chosen Form I keeps the relief calm and positional, not the agitation of the Form IV field, not merely downward reduction, and not an untying image; the birth/delivery branch remains only a secondary image of bringing a carried load out and away. The wider place and position field makes the act a change of status as well as location. The verb also continues the prior inner-expansion scene from 94:1 by shifting from opened capacity to weight taken off, while the paired roots make the placer/remover act on the burden root in a constrained local pairing. Even the sound contour supports that movement, opening broadly before closing on the named load.

words.prose: {{ar:عَنْكَ}} ({{tr:ʿanka}}) is the hinge that gives {{ar:وَضَعْنَا}} ({{tr:waḍaʿnā}}) its removal direction. The preposition selects separation rather than a looser concerning/about sense: the addressee becomes the load-bearing source from which weight is lifted, while {{ar:وِزْرَكَ}} ({{tr:wizraka}}) remains the thing acted upon. Its position before the burden foregrounds the relieved person before the load is named. Against the benefit-directed movement of 94:1, this phrase reverses the vector: favor was directed toward the addressee, and weight is now taken from him. The repeated second-person ending in this phrase and in the burden noun makes the source and the possessed load land as a paired cadence, so removal and personal possession stay bound together.

words.prose: {{ar:وِزْرَكَ}} ({{tr:wizraka}}) closes the ayah by naming the object that {{ar:وَضَعْنَا}} ({{tr:waḍaʿnā}}) has moved {{ar:عَنْكَ}} ({{tr:ʿanka}}). The suffix makes the burden personal and definite, while the accusative object role makes it the thing acted upon; the same addressee is therefore both the one relieved and the one to whom the load is attached. Its singular possessed form compresses many possible pressures into one manipulable object. Its range is not a flat abstraction: weight, liability, mission-load, and responsibility converge as one removable load, later characterized through back-breaking pressure in 94:3 and intensified by the wider carrying field. The root's minister/helper and bearer branches remain responsibility pressure, but the local form and distribution favor the carried burden itself rather than an office-holder. The final position makes the noun the endpoint that resolves what was removed, while the verb-preposition-object mechanism shows why the burden is not merely named but actively lifted. Against no-bearer burden formulae (6:164; 17:15; 35:18), this clause does not transfer the burden to another bearer; it presents divine removal. Its compressed middle sound and repeated second-person ending give the burden audible weight and bind it back to the source phrase. The same suffix chain also keeps 94:1 and 94:2 in one address frame: inner capacity is opened, then outer load is removed from the same addressee.

topics.reason: The cited formulae (6:164; 17:15; 35:18) are valid contrastive echoes, but the local grammar describes divine removal rather than burden transfer to another human bearer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction وَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ makes the possessed object at word 3 the thing displaced away from the addressee by the verb at word 1.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two dominant branch images form a load-transfer scene: a heavy thing formerly borne by the addressee is deliberately set down off that bearer. Relief is therefore spatial and material before it is psychological.

activation_trace.role: Setting an object down or into a settled place supplies the downward displacement and endpoint of the event.
A heavy carried load supplies the object whose bearer-position is changed.

changed_reading.before: We relieved you of an unspecified burden.
changed_reading.after: We physically unload from you what had occupied the position of a heavy carried load, setting it somewhere other than on its bearer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The away-vector in عَنكَ can mark reassignment rather than annihilation, while both focus roots contain branch images of placed loads and another person carrying a principal's weight.
baseline_models.mechanism: The burden is redistributed into an arrangement of assigned bearers or support. What leaves the addressee can continue to exist as a responsibility, but no longer as a solitary load.

activation_trace.role: Assigned people, soldiers, or loads supply an organized destination for what is moved off the addressee.
The helper or minister who carries another's weight supplies delegated load-bearing rather than simple deletion.

changed_reading.before: The burden simply ceased to exist.
changed_reading.after: The burden was taken out of your sole charge and reassigned into a supporting arrangement that can bear it with or for you.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus noun at word 3 has a branch for war equipment, and the governing verb can describe putting an object down.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same syntax that depicts unloading can depict decommissioning: equipment carried for conflict is taken off and laid down, ending a state of armed readiness.

activation_trace.role: Putting something down supplies the concrete act of laying aside equipment.
The gear of war supplies a specific load and turns unloading into disarmament.

changed_reading.before: A moral or emotional weight was removed.
changed_reading.after: Your conflict-loadout was taken off you and laid down, changing the ayah into a scene of de-escalation or demobilization.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus verb's childbirth branch is unusually exact in treating a carried pregnancy as something laid down, while the object is explicitly a heavy carried burden.
baseline_models.mechanism: Removal can be a delivery rather than subtraction: a long-carried weight reaches a threshold, separates from its bearer, and opens a new phase. The result is not necessarily nothingness; something may emerge from the release.

activation_trace.role: Laying down a pregnancy in birth supplies release through culmination and separation from a bearer.
The heavy carried load supplies the gestational weight that can be brought to delivery.

changed_reading.before: A burden was lifted away in one clean act.
changed_reading.after: A burden you had carried was brought to term and delivered from you, making relief a difficult threshold that can produce a new condition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus verb includes abatement from capital, and عَنكَ permits an obligation-like weight to be reduced from the addressee's account.
baseline_models.mechanism: The burden behaves like a liability written down through a loss borne elsewhere. This preserves a cost rather than pretending that relief is costless.

activation_trace.role: Reduction of trading capital through loss supplies the concrete logic of an abatement or write-down.
A heavy burden supplies the obligation-like debit removed from the addressee.
Securing and taking something away supplies the transfer side of the write-down rather than pure disappearance.

changed_reading.before: Relief had no visible accounting or cost.
changed_reading.after: A weight standing against you was abated and taken off your account, with the image retaining the possibility that another side absorbs the loss.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The dominant inventory for the focus noun includes refuge or mountain shelter, so the direct object can lexically be a protective recourse rather than a burden.
baseline_models.mechanism: Read with عَنكَ, the act becomes unsettling: an owned refuge is detached from the addressee. Focus-only evidence does not decide whether this is deprivation, exposure, or release from a defensive dependence.

activation_trace.role: Setting something away from its former bearer supplies the detachment of a protective object.
Refuge or fortified shelter supplies the surprising object removed from the addressee.

changed_reading.before: The act is self-evidently beneficial because the object is a burden.
changed_reading.after: Your own refuge was detached from you; the focus alone leaves open whether this is dangerous exposure or liberation from a defensive enclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding opening of the chest, especially the chest as an origin from which acts issue, moves the burden scene inward. The removal can alter the generating center of action rather than merely subtract an external package.

changed_reading.before: Disarmament is only the abstract decision to stop fighting.
changed_reading.after: A fitted conflict apparatus is unbound from your back and laid down, making peace a bodily de-rigging rather than a mere change of intention.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired first-person-plural acts distribute verticality selectively: the load and its degrading downward pressure are put down, while the addressee's public standing and remembered name are raised. Relief is an exchange of what occupies the high and low positions.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies persistent difficulty, opening, and lighter movement; I infer that unloading is the enabling change that makes movement possible within hardship. A live alternative is that the repeated assurance is independent of the focus act.

changed_reading.after: The difficult situation may remain, but its crushing load is taken off so that an opening and maneuverability coexist with it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus childbirth branch meets a context branch for obstructed or difficult birth and a repeated opening into ease. The burden is delivered through labor: release is costly, thresholded, and potentially generative rather than instantaneous subtraction.

changed_reading.before: The burden is lifted without process or residue.
changed_reading.after: The burden is delivered through constricted labor into an opening, so relief is a generative passage whose difficulty is not denied.

changed_reading.before: The burden is an unpriced inner feeling.
changed_reading.after: A liability crushing someone of limited means is written down from that person's side, restoring usable capacity while acknowledging that remission has a cost.

changed_reading.after: The old crushing load is removed to empty capacity and restore an upright stance for a new exertion that is chosen and directed.

strongest_changes: The relative clause in 94:3 turns an unspecified burden into a mechanically diagnosed load that makes the back creak.
The mirrored downward and upward verbs of 94:2 and 94:4 selectively lower the load while raising the bearer's public standing.
The repeated coexistence of hardship and ease revises removal from total problem-erasure into restored maneuverability within continuing difficulty.
The childbirth and difficult-birth branches preserve a generative model in which release occurs through labor and passage.
The emptying and upright-effort sequence in 94:7 makes unloading a reset for new directed exertion rather than terminal rest.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports several mechanisms that cannot be safely merged: unloading, delegated support, disarmament, delivery, economic abatement, and detachment from refuge. Context both stabilizes the physical load model and activates stranger but inspectable readings, especially the birth/ease chain and the non-dominant mapping's chest, speech, textile, and directional images.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus-only refuge reading has unresolved valence; 94:8 can reframe it as transferred reliance, but that causal arrow remains reader-supplied.
The economic model is coherent across capital abatement, lack of means, and sufficiency, yet the packet does not itself state that the burden is debt.
The childbirth model has unusually strong branch resonance across focus and context but remains form-distant from the ordinary construction.
The non-dominant mapped-root outliers are traceable activations rather than claims that those images control the primary lexical reading.
The context sequence strongly invites causal integration, while parallel, non-causal enumeration remains live for several deltas.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. The primary mechanism is load removal from the body. Lexical evidence: `و ض ع B001` setting something down or in its place, `و ز ر B002` heavy burden; 94:3 `ن ق ض B005` creaking under strain and `ظ ه ر B002` anatomical back. Structural cue: 94:2 names the load’s removal, and 94:3 immediately identifies the load by its effect on the back. Assigned role: `وضع` is the downward transfer, `وزر` is the load, and `ظهر` is the support that had borne it. Abductive move supplied by me: removal is inferred as causal explanation for the chest opening and later ease. Reading change: the ayah reads as a mechanical unburdening whose evidence appears in the next ayah’s strained sound.

2. The burden is also a false refuge or transferred support. Lexical evidence: `و ز ر B001` refuge/shelter, `و ز ر B004` supporting minister/helper, and `ر ب ب B001/B002` final lordship and nurture. Structural cue: the burden is taken “from you,” while the passage ends by directing رغبة to `رَبِّكَ`. Assigned role: `وزر` can be what one relies on for protection or help; its removal clears the relation so support is no longer carried by the addressed person. Abductive move supplied by me: some shelters become loads when they are borne as self-support. Reading change: the ayah is not only forgiveness/relief of weight; it is relocation of dependence from carried support to divine lordship.

3. The laying-down is activated as birth/delivery. Lexical evidence: `و ض ع B002` laying down a pregnancy in birth; `ر ح م B003/B004` womb and womb pain after birth; `ع س ر B006` difficult childbirth; `ي س ر B001` ease/readiness and `ي س ر B006` productive increase. Structural cue: mercy/womb terms open the packet; the doubled hardship/ease couplet follows the burden episode. Assigned role: the `وزر` is a carried thing brought to term and set down. Abductive move supplied by me: the context’s womb, hardship, and ease branches let “placing down” be heard as delivery out of constriction. Reading change: the ayah becomes release-through-birth, not merely dropping an object.

4. A weaker legal-economic reading is preserved. Lexical evidence: `و ض ع B004` reducing capital through loss, `ص د ر B005` settling liability on money, `ع س ر B002/B003` insolvency and pressing an insolvent debtor, `ي س ر B003` prosperity and means, `ذ ك ر B008` rights document. Structural cue: the sequence from burden to repeated ease activates debt/means vocabulary across roots. Assigned role: the “burden” can behave like a liability that is abated. Abductive move supplied by me: the passage’s relief may include release from an accounting claim. Reading change: the ayah can be heard as cancellation or reduction of an imposed liability, though this reading is secondary because the immediate body/back cue is stronger.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The later surprise was that `وَضَعْنَا` did not end the action; 94:7’s `فَٱنصَبْ` showed a down/up alternation: the burden is set down so the person can be set upright. 94:8 also made the refuge/helper senses of `و ز ر B001/B004` more important than they first appeared, because the final desire moves toward `رَبِّكَ` as the true support. The financial-liability reading gained support from 94:5-6 only after `ع س ر` and `ي س ر` activated insolvency/means; without those later ayat it would have remained much weaker.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Unloading that restores an upright working posture.** Fixed `و ض ع/B001` is setting something down from the hand or into a lower place, and fixed `و ز ر/B002` is a heavy carried load. The relative clause in 94:3 identifies the load by its creaking effect on the back (`ن ق ض/B005`), while 94:7 later commands `ن ص ب/B001`, setting or standing upright. The two fixed branches stage an actual lowering of weight; the later upright branch supplies the reversal. **Abductive move:** I infer set-down load -> recovered posture -> renewed activity; only the endpoints and sequence are packet-given. **Reading change:** removal is an ergonomic transfer off the body that enables standing work, not an unexplained disappearance.

2. **A carried process reaching delivery.** Fixed `و ض ع/B002` supplies childbirth as laying down a pregnancy, while fixed `و ز ر/B002` supplies the carried heaviness. The window also contains `ر ح م/B003` womb in 94:0, back-strain in 94:3, `ع س ر/B006` difficult labor and `ي س ر/B001` opening in 94:5, and a new task in 94:7. These branches occupy the roles container, gestational load, labor-strain, release, and post-delivery phase. **Abductive move:** I infer that these dispersed images describe one reproductive process; pregnancy is not asserted by the surface construction. **Reading change:** setting down the burden can be heard as productive delivery after carrying, so relief begins a new phase rather than merely discarding something alien.

3. **Exploratory: relinquishing a shelter that had become a load.** Fixed `و ز ر/B001` is refuge or mountain shelter, while `و ز ر/B002` is burden; the same surface can therefore activate a protective-weight ambiguity. Fixed `و ض ع/B001` gives the act of putting that mass down, and the opening, mercy, and repeated ease around it supply an alternative mode of security. **Abductive move:** I infer that a defensive refuge had itself become burdensome and could be relinquished because another protection was operative; the packet does not identify such a refuge. **Reading change:** “your burden” also becomes an overbuilt defense whose removal exposes the addressee to relief rather than danger.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 94:3 confirmed that the thing set down had measurable bodily force, preventing `و ض ع/B001` from remaining a merely abstract removal. The largest later surprise came from 94:5 and 94:7: childbirth difficulty/opening made `و ض ع/B002` into delivery, while the later `ن ص ب/B001` upright command exposed a down/up postural reversal and showed that relief transfers the addressee into fresh action.

findings.text: Yükün aşağıya alınması, hemen sonraki bedensel baskıyı giderip daha ileride yeniden doğrularak çalışmayı mümkün kılan mekanik bir boşaltmadır.
Taşınan ağırlığın bırakılması, rahim, doğum sancısı ve açılma çağrışımlarıyla, yabancı bir şeyi atmaktan çok taşıma sürecini üretken bir doğuma ulaştırır.
Yük, koruma sağlarken kendisi ağırlaşmış bir sığınak olarak da düşünülebilir; kaldırılması, savunmacı bir kabuğun bırakılması anlamını kazanır.
Yardımcı veya dayanak olarak taşınan şeyin kaldırılması, dayanma ilişkisini kişinin kendi üzerinde taşıdığı destekten son ayetteki Rabbe taşır.
Yükün bırakılması, zorluk ve imkânın mali çağrışımları içinde, kişiye yüklenmiş bir borç veya mali sorumluluğun azaltılması olarak da okunabilir.

butuncul_okuma_line.raw_line: **94:2.** وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ — Birincil okuma: Ayet, ağır yükün kişinin üzerinden indirilmesi ve yere konmasıdır. Sırtı gıcırdatan ağırlık bunu mekanik bir rahatlama kılarken, doğum ve borç dalları yükün hem taşınmış bir doğum sancısı hem de hafifletilmiş bir sorumluluk olarak okunmasını sağlar; gerçek dayanak ise finalde Rabbe taşınır. {و ض ع B001; و ض ع B002; و ض ع B004; و ز ر B001; و ز ر B002; و ز ر B004; ن ق ض B005; ظ ه ر B002; ع س ر B006; ي س ر B003}

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, anlamın çekirdeğini bir doğrultudan yana eğilme, amaçlanan yönden ayrılma ve başka yana dönme olarak açıkça kurar. Çöl, kuyu, kap ve yay örnekleri bu çekirdeğin farklı fiziksel gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal genel eğilme ve yönünden ayrılmadır; yalan, ziyaret, göğüs veya yöneticilik anlamlarını kendi kapsamına almaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın kullanıma dayanır; tanım herhangi bir özel söz öbeğine bağlı olmayan eğilme ve yön değiştirme çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin amaçlanan doğrultudan ayrılması, başka yana dönmesi veya fiziksel olarak yana eğilmesidir. Bu çekirdek, eğri biçimli nesnelere ve bakış ya da duruştaki yana kaymaya uygulanabilir.

facets.statement: Amaçlanan yön, yol veya duruştan yana doğru ayrılma ve başka tarafa dönme.
Bir nesnenin biçiminde, bir canlının duruşunda veya bakışında fiziksel yana eğrilik bulunması.
Yolundan uzaklaşmış arazi, dibi uzak kuyu, eğri kap ve yay bu yönelme biçiminin örnekleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, yön veya amaç çizgisinden ayrılma ile fiziksel yana eğilmeyi ortak çekirdek olarak verir; nesne ve duruş örnekleri bu çekirdeği somutlaştırır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem amaçlanan doğrultudan ayrılmayı hem de fiziksel yana eğrilik gösteren yalın kullanımları birlikte karşılar.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, orta çizgiden ayrılmanın yanında bir kişiye destek için yönelmeyi ve çok çeşitli yapısal eğrilikleri de kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdekler büyük ölçüde örtüşür; ancak komşu dalın destek amacıyla birine yönelme ve geniş yapısal eğrilik alanı odak dalın sınırını aşar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, gerçekten ayrılmış söz anlamındaki yalanı ve buna bağlı olarak doğru kabul edilmemesi gereken tapınma nesnesini birlikte tanıklar. Yalancı tanıklık ve doğru olmayan söz, yalan çekirdeğinin belirli kullanımlarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalan ve gerçekten sapmış batıl şeylerle sınırlıdır; ziyaret, fiziksel eğilme ve sözü konuşmadan önce düzenleme bu dalın çekirdeği değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal hem yalın yalan ve batıl nesne anlamlarını hem de doğru olmayan söz kalıbını içerir; söz kalıbının kapsamı yalın biçimin bütün anlamlarına yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Gerçekten ve doğrudan ayrılmış söz, hüküm veya tanıklıktır. Bu sapma düşüncesi, hak etmediği halde tanrılaştırılıp tapınılan nesnenin adlandırılmasına da genişler.

facets.statement: Gerçekle uyuşmayan, doğruluktan ayrılmış yalan veya batıl içerik.
Doğru olmayan söz ve yalancı tanıklık biçimindeki söz öbeğine bağlı kullanım.
Gerçek tanrılık niteliği taşımadığı halde tanrılaştırılıp tapınılan nesne.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yalanı doğruluk yolundan sapma olarak açıklar, yalancı tanıklığı bunun sözlü gerçekleşmesi sayar ve aynı adlandırmayı batıl tapınma nesnesine genişletir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kişiye yönelip onu görmeye gitme eylemini, bu eylemi yapan kişiyi ve topluluğu açıkça tanıklar. Ziyaretçiyi ağırlama ile kadınlarla sık görüşen erkek anlamları, aynı alandaki özel ve bağımlı kullanımlardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal birini görmek üzere ona yönelme ve bunun katılımcılarıyla sınırlıdır; konukluk, yalın yönelme veya tel ve keten anlamları bu çekirdeğe katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın kullanıma dayanır; tanım görmeye gitme eylemini temel alır ve özel kişi ya da ağırlama kullanımlarını bu çekirdeğe bağımlı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimseyi görmek veya onunla buluşmak amacıyla yanına gitmek ve ona yönelmektir; bu eylemi yapan kişi ya da topluluk da aynı anlam alanındadır. Ziyaretçiyi ağırlama ve kadınlarla sık görüşüp sohbet eden erkek anlamları özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir kişiyi görmek veya onunla buluşmak için yanına gitme ve ona yönelme.
Görmeye giden kişi ile bu kişilerden oluşan topluluğun adlandırılması.
Görmeye gelen kişiyi iyi karşılayıp ağırlama.
Kadınların yanına sık gidip onlarla görüşmeyi ve sohbet etmeyi seven erkek.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, görmeye gitme eylemi ile ziyaretçi ve ziyaretçi topluluğunu ortak biçimde tanıklar; ağırlama ve kadınlarla sık görüşen erkek kullanımları bu alanın özel uzantılarıdır.
